items.repo: A small JavaScript library: src/calc.js exports add and sub; test.js asserts their behaviour.
items.task_a: Refactor src/calc.js: rename the function add to sum (update every use, including test.js), add a JSDoc comment above every function in src/calc.js, and add a function mul(a, b) that returns a * b with a test in test.js. Run node test.js when done.
items.task_b: Harden src/calc.js: the add function must throw a TypeError if either argument is not a number, and add a function div(a, b) that returns a / b and throws an Error on division by zero. Add tests for both in test.js. Run node test.js when done.
